name: Vercel
summary: Vercel is a cloud platform for deploying web apps and backends, increasingly positioned for AI agents. Its Functions run on Fluid compute, which lets one instance serve many concurrent requests, keeps working after the response with waitUntil, and bills on active CPU rather than wall-clock time, which suits agents that spend most time waiting on models. Related services include AI Gateway, Sandbox, Queues, Workflows and Drives for persistent agent storage.
facts: 300s on Hobby; 800s on Pro/Enterprise (30 min in beta)
AI Gateway, Sandbox, Queues, Workflows, Drives
goodFor: Agents that mostly wait on model calls
Pairing hosting with durable workflows and an AI gateway
watchOut: Function duration limits; long runs need Workflows or Queues
Usage-based bills can be hard to predict
Many features tie you to Vercel-specific services
